prompts.note: Any of HDB's official towns or estates.

prompts.text: Name one of Singapore's 55 planning areas
prompts.note: URA's official planning areas, from Ang Mo Kio to Yishun (and some empty-sounding ones in between).

prompts.text: Name an island of Singapore (not the main island!)
prompts.note: Any existing offshore island, natural or reclaimed (Sentosa Cove's islands count). Islets in lakes and the little beach islets off Sentosa don't.

prompts.text: Name a park, garden or nature reserve in Singapore
prompts.note: Parks, gardens, nature parks and nature reserves count. Park connectors don't.

answers.name: Mandai Mangrove and Mudflat Nature Park

prompts.text: Name a shopping mall along Orchard Road
prompts.note: Malls just off Orchard Road count too (Scotts Road, Tanglin Road, Dhoby Ghaut). Closed or demolished malls don't.
Hawker centres and markets with cooked-food stalls. Coffee shops and food courts don't count.
